summary.text: Eva Romero is the Republican candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 60 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Democrat Shaundelle Brooks.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a former high school history teacher and business owner who serves as a Governor-appointed commissioner on the Tennessee Housing Development Agency.

paragraphs.text: Romero said in a Ballotpedia survey that she was raised in poverty by a single mother, was the first in her family to graduate high school and attend college, and taught high school history before starting a business.
She said she became the first Latina to franchise with Century 21 in Tennessee and, with her husband Dr. Jaime Romero, co-founded Solace Oral Surgery & Implant Center.
She described herself as a mother of five and a resident of Old Hickory Village, and said Gov. Bill Lee appointed her to the Tennessee Housing Development Agency.
Romero advanced from the Republican primary on August 6, 2026.

Her stated priorities in the survey include a cap on annual property tax increases, a property tax freeze for residents over 65 on their primary residence, support for police use of license plate readers, and a new vocational school in Old Hickory.
